preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 100,000.
The number of roads m is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= x_i, y_i <= n and x_i != y_i
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities with numbers between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: There is at most one road between each pair of cities.
preconditions.description: No road connects a city to itself, and each pair of cities is connected by no more than one road.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of separated cities after the reform.
